facts.business: Consecutive Commodities Limited is engaged in the sale of goods, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control to customers, primarily upon delivery.

auditor.name: M/s. Kapil Kumar Aggarwal & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Management did not furnish balance confirmation letters, party-wise reconciliation statements, and age-wise analysis for certain Trade Receivable and Trade Payable balances as at 31st March 2026, so the auditor was unable to satisfy themselves on existence, completeness, accuracy, and recoverability. 2) Satisfactory supporting documents for completeness of valuation of inventory as on 31st March 2026 were not provided. 3) The Company, being a listed entity, did not appoint an Internal Auditor for the entire Financial Year 2025-26, constituting non-compliance with Section 138 of the Companies Act, 2013. 4) The company has significant trade payables; however, the bifurcation/details were not provided (text truncated).

key_risks: Lack of balance confirmations and reconciliations for trade receivables and payables
Insufficient supporting documentation for inventory valuation
Non-appointment of Internal Auditor for FY 2025-26 leading to significant gap in internal control framework
Significant trade payables without adequate bifurcation/details
